## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its Modern UI rationale.

## Verification

List the commands, platforms, interactions, and visual states verified.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows `doc/design.md` and Flutter conventions.
- [ ] Applicable pointer, touch, keyboard, focus, disabled, and semantic states
      are covered.
- [ ] RTL, reduced motion, text scaling, high contrast, and theme precedence
      were considered.
- [ ] Tests, Gallery examples, documentation, and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated as
      applicable.
- [ ] Public API changes are documented and reflected in the API inventory and
      freeze review.
- [ ] Changed Golden and package-preview images were inspected intentionally.
- [ ] Local analysis, tests, screenshot guard, and publish dry-run pass.
